subject.title: feat(feeds): search and follow signed publisher feeds

question: Should signed publisher-feed discovery and durable following be a supported OpenClaw core CLI/state feature, or should the ClawHub-specific workflow ship as a plugin or ClawHub package using existing seams?
rationale: The patch is a substantial new user-facing and persistent core surface, and repository policy reserves optional service-specific workflows for plugin/ClawHub ownership when current extension seams are adequate.

options.title: Route it to a plugin or ClawHub package
options.body: Keep core limited to generic signed-feed primitives and publish the publisher-follow workflow through the appropriate extension surface.

options.title: Sponsor the core workflow
options.body: Accept `publisher` as a durable core CLI contract, then require exact-head live HTTPS proof and explicit upgrade/storage ownership before merge.

recommendation.title: Route it to a plugin or ClawHub package
recommendation.body: Keep core limited to generic signed-feed primitives and publish the publisher-follow workflow through the appropriate extension surface.

likelyOwner.reason: A named current-main owner cannot be established from the provided history without inventing attribution; the protected maintainer route should select the sponsor.
